book.name: Apanll Chtarangu
book.title: Apanll chtarangu anu Apanll chtakchuri ashirangu anu

content: Ashiriya, na Aprahamarini wizanll, Sararini tsiparangu anoo kamanchintspa
Sararini masachirini 127 taaramchu, yakat Hebronush, Kanaanash tsap tsiparangiya. Aprahamarinsha wizanllingaz kapung tanurangiya.

Tsiparee kasayaranllu, wamkuripsha tsiyatati átu, naatarangiya. Aprahamarini wamkurish Hititshuchish kuseeramchu, Nuw siyaa átana: Arapchitaateena, nuw siyash kusaranguri, nuwaam tsapuneetsis mapshishee tupaxanxangasinda. Izanllini tsipar mappi aturi atina, tárangiya.

Hititshuchsha: Zuwaa, mazinanganlla; Arapchitaateesha ashiru, itaru shiyaa kis napkiniya. Watam shiysha kizpur kurak ashirush iyash taakshawa. Mapiyrush izanllinish tsipar mapungsi. Mapshish iyash kizpur wanasireewcha taaru, napeerush, yuwash shaana zandkish anush mapungsi. Antaati iy ¿mayaamaja mapshisheetssha pachindchinee? Uru mapumaam taariya, táranganaya.
Aprahamarinshitini much tsapush timucheeru, Hititshuchee tasaseeru, Zurkeesa átus, nishuripari izanllineetsi tsiparee mapchina. Ashiriya, nuwamun suri Efronaa, Sojararinee wip mashangints.

Mapshish patumbich wach, Makpela sur paxanxpi átana. Waanpatatari watimburanll paxanxpi atina. ¿Wanipamasaja waritakiya? Nuwshat anuritam tuwapachina. Ashkachinareena, nuwaamatarishapari mapshishireemi payuchina, tárangiya.
Efronsha Hititshuch mazinazinaw ashirangiya. Efronsha waani tputs chapungucheewtamta mazinapana átu kapunguri tsiyatarangiya.

Ichee, amb tárinllpa. ¿Mayaamaja nuw shiyaam tipuranlleetsi tupaxanxachi? Ngutariti panachinllpa. Annungirtam patumbich wach taariya tsipareem mapumaama. Iyashuch ichingarusin partamsin, shiyaam ngutariti panachinllpa. Anush izanllinish mapungsi, tárangiya.
Itaru, Aprahamarinshitini yusur tsapush tutunlltayaru, much timucheeru,
Efronaa: Ayu, tángcha. Kurik tuwapachinllpa tipuranllimandish. Ashiramchuri, annaapari mapiyashti, izanllineetsi mapuchshitina, tárangiya.
Efronsha: Ichee, mazinangcha. Timburanlliz 400 kurik waritakiya. Ashiritaa, mapiyrush izanllinish mapungcha, tárangiya.
Aprahamarinsha anuritam kurikee yáyaru, tatsamooru tuwaparangiya. Ashparitam Efron táyaru anuritamta 400 kurikee panarangiya Hititshucheema. Wanasir tácheeru tuwaparangiya.
Ashirucha, Efronaa watsapun ichingaru ashpari watimburanllee mapshishpatari paxanxarangiya, yapeem Mamre tsap tatsumawtam taarangu anootsi.
Anoo ichingaru Aprahamaammarisha yarangiya. Hititshuchsha tputs ichingarusin anoo paranganaya.
Amb ashiramchu, anacha Aprahamarini wizanllinaa tsiparee yáyaru, Makpelash wach pshtayaru, mapurangshita. Makpel wach Kanaanash tsap taariya, yap Mamre, Hebron ashiru tsap taarangu ambi.

Amb sheersin, Hititshuch waanaatsi watsapun Makpelaa Aprahamarineemi tupaxanxarangiya patumbchee wachu. Aprahamarinsha anoo tsap waamatarisha yarangiya tsipareemtam mapshisheema. Ashiriya, na kamaneena yuwaa Sararini tsiparangu anootsi.
